title: SkillScrolls
description: SkillScrolls is a configurable skill-tree plugin that lets players earn skill points, unlock upgrades through an in-game GUI, and automatically applies persistent RPG stat effects across sessions.
body:
**SkillScrolls** — an RPG plugin featuring a Skill Tree and a custom GUI powered by a resource pack.
Players gain levels, earn skill points, and upgrade perks with effects (attributes/potions).

The skill tree is fully configurable via skills.yml and tree.yml, and the interface works through custom models and fonts.

## Commands
- /skills — open the skill tree.
- /stats — display level, experience, and skill points.
- /skillscrolls pack — send a resource pack installation request to the player.
- /skillscrollsreload — reload config.yml, skills.yml, tree.yml (requires skillscrolls.admin).
- /rpgreload — reload config.yml and skills.yml (requires skillscrolls.admin).
- Permissions
- skillscrolls.admin — access to reload commands.

## Permissions
skillscrolls.admin — access to reload commands.
